findings.title: Wireframe task and feed actions missing: Reassign via new attempt, Request diagnostic, Branch from retained evidence, Filter raw trace
findings.wireframe_ref: wireframes.html line 252: Task controls 'Reassign via new attempt'; Execution feed disclosure 'Filter raw trace', 'Request diagnostic', 'Branch from retained evidence'
findings.evidence: Live, task selected: no button matching /reassign/i. The Execution feed disclosure shows explanatory text and the timeline only. Non-test grep of apps/desktop/src finds no 'Request diagnostic', 'Branch from retained evidence', 'Reassign via' or 'Filter raw trace'. Task controls offer 'Preview retry' (TaskControls.tsx:138) plus disabled 'Amend TaskContract' and 'Request new decomposition'. Spec operational-design.md:413 lists 'assign or reassign tasks' and 'request a diagnostic, amend future context, or branch from retained evidence'. Other unavailable actions in this view use disabled-with-reason; these are absent entirely.
findings.suspected_root_cause: Not built in TaskControls.tsx or SessionDetail.tsx Disclosure. Retry is the only reassignment path. Hypothesis: these were left out rather than rendered disabled, unlike the amend and decomposition actions.
findings.check: test('agents-05 wireframe task and feed actions are offered', async ({ page }) => { await openApp(page, '#/agents', 'populated', 'desktop'); await page.getByRole('button', { name: /fixture:task-running/ }).click(); await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /reassign/i })).toBeVisible(); await page.locator('summary', { hasText: 'Execution feed, side effects and supplied context' }).click(); await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /request diagnostic/i })).toBeVisible(); await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /branch from retained evidence/i })).toBeVisible(); });

findings.title: Selected detail omits TaskContract, workspace/base revision, heartbeat and per-attempt facts the wireframe shows
findings.wireframe_ref: wireframes.html line 252: subtitle 'TaskContract v4 · Context C9 · API workspace W12 · Base revision b7e21'; 'Attempt 3 · Running ... Heartbeat: 5 seconds ago'; per-attempt failure reasons
findings.evidence: App populated aside text: title, id, state pill, objective, 'Agent fixture:codex', 'Attempt history' (Attempt 1 fixture:attempt-r1 Running), 'Sessions'. Absent: contract version, workspace, base revision, heartbeat, latest useful event, attempt failure reason. The daemon supplies these: daemon/types.ts:115 (task contract) and daemon/types.ts:340 (workspace {id, branch, base_commit}). Side effects and supplied context are honestly stated as 'not recorded by the daemon' (SessionDetail.tsx Disclosure) and are not counted here. Spec operational-design.md:411 lists workspace/base revision, observation age, checkpoint and useful progress in the detail.
findings.suspected_root_cause: views/agents/model.ts WorkRow/rowFromTask carries only id, state, objective, agent, attempts (id, state, number) and sessions. SessionDetail.tsx Selected() renders only those. TaskRecord contract version and workspace base_commit are not mapped.

findings.title: Failed and Disconnected lists count tasks, but wireframe and spec count sessions; '0 disconnected sessions' chip counts tasks
findings.wireframe_ref: wireframes.html line 251 tabs 'Failed sessions', 'Disconnected'; line 248 chip '0 disconnected sessions'; spec operational-design.md:411 'failed sessions, and disconnected sessions with explicit denominators'
findings.evidence: App tabs: 'Failed (1)' lists fixture:task-failed, a task whose state is Failed. 'Disconnected (0)' lists tasks. The chip '0 disconnected sessions' comes from model.ts disconnected(), which counts active TASKS with recovery classification needs-inspection, not sessions. The tabs and chips therefore mix task and session denominators ('Counts cover 3 task(s)').
findings.suspected_root_cause: views/agents/model.ts: TABS labels 'Failed' and 'Disconnected' use tabRows(), which filters task state; headline().disconnected counts tasks. No session-level derivation exists.
findings.check: test('agents-07 failed tab names sessions', async ({ page }) => { await openApp(page, '#/agents', 'populated', 'desktop'); await expect(page.getByRole('tab', { name: /^Failed sessions/ })).toBeVisible(); });

findings.title: Empty state reads as unknown: 'Execution status is unknown because the task list is not available' for an empty list; tab counts stuck at (…). Looks broken
findings.wireframe_ref: none: wireframe #agents-sessions defines no empty state
findings.evidence: app/agents.empty.desktop.aria.yml: region 'Execution status' -> status 'Execution status is unknown because the task list is not available.' Tabs 'Active (…)', 'Queued (…)', 'Failed (…)', 'Disconnected (…)', 'Available (0)'. Panel shows 'No tasks'. Looks broken: the list is available and empty (work.status === 'empty'), so the status should read 0 running and 0 queued and the tabs (0). The live daemon path returns ready with [] (useAgentsData.ts work memo), so this affects fixture/preview mode. Spec 'explicit denominators' at operational-design.md:411 supports showing zero.
findings.suspected_root_cause: AgentsView.tsx:66-68 treats any non-ready work status as unknown; SessionList.tsx label() returns '(…)' whenever work.status !== 'ready' (about line 55).
findings.check: test('agents-16 empty list shows zero counts, not unknown', async ({ page }) => { await openApp(page, '#/agents', 'empty', 'desktop'); await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Execution status' })).not.toContainText('not available'); await expect(page.getByRole('tab', { name: /^Active \(0\)/ })).toBeVisible(); });

findings.title: Later-scope routing items absent (Editable routing preferences, T18 recommendation notice, ceilings/timeouts control); Review routing proposal and Choose manual assignment shown disabled
findings.wireframe_ref: wireframes.html line 253: Scheduling, routing and resource policy · Later-scope preview (Why tasks wait, Editable routing preferences, T18 notice, controls)
findings.evidence: App populated desktop Scheduling disclosure: 'Why tasks wait' with concurrency and queue reasons, plus disabled 'Review routing proposal' ('Not available: the daemon records no routing proposals.') and 'Choose manual assignment' ('Not available: the daemon has no method to assign an agent to an existing task.'). No 'Editable routing preferences' list, no T18 notice, no 'Set ceilings' button.
findings.justification: operational-design.md:783 ('Some future controls appear in the comprehensive wireframe ... labels them as later scope. Their presence is not a release claim'); wireframe labels the block 'Later-scope preview'; LaterScope.tsx reason strings state the daemon limits.
